2022 FERRARI SF90 SPIDER

FIORANO PACKAGE, RACING SEATS, BLU MEDIO INTERIOR, LOW MILES, AND MORE!

OVERVIEW
The 2022 Ferrari SF90 Spider is an embodiment of Ferrari mid-engine V8 mastery and a direct descendant of Maranello, Italy's most celebrated performance lineage. As the brand's first production PHEV, the SF90 combines electrification with traditional Ferrari soul, creating an experience that is technologically advanced yet still emotionally intoxicating. Under the rear glass sits a 4.0-liter twin-turbocharged V8, paired with three electric motors for a combined output of 986 horsepower. Power is sent to all four wheels through an 8-speed dual-clutch transmission, making the SF90 the first Ferrari plug-in hybrid with AWD. The result? A blistering 0-60 mph in just 2.5 seconds and handling precision that pushes the limits of what a road car can do. Rather than a rear spoiler that raises above certain speeds, the SF90 activates its active aero features by dropping a wedge-shaped panel to reveal a Gurney flap spoiler––a fast-acting system that generates as much as 860 pounds of downforce. Behind the wheel, the cabin wraps the driver in Blu Medio Alcantara/leather, with Ferrari's signature manettino steering wheel and carbon fiber trim reminding you of its performance intentions. The integration of digital displays with classic analog cues ensures a driving experience that is both modern and timeless. Every switch, paddle, and display is positioned toward the driver for maximum engagement, while your plus one gets the thrill of roof-down driving in one well-rounded package.

The interior showcases Ferrari's attention to detail with bespoke leather and Alcantara floor mats, a carbon fiber driver zone with integrated lighting, and meticulously appointed racing seats designed for both comfort and support. The Giallo Modena accent stitching on the steering wheel and F1 shift paddles provides a distinctive personal touch.

With its hybrid powertrain, this SF90 Spider balances extraordinary performance with efficiency. The convertible design offers the freedom of open-air driving while the advanced aerodynamic package ensures stability at high speeds. Key comfort features include automatic climate control, heated mirrors, a navigation system, rear parking sensors with camera, and comprehensive safety technology including electronic stability control and adaptive suspension.

The vehicle's near-showroom condition and comprehensive factory warranty protection reflect careful ownership. The full paint protection film preserves the pristine Nero Daytona finish, while all premium upgrades—from the premium audio system to the adaptive lighting—remain in perfect working order.

This SF90 Spider Assetto Fiorano invites you to experience Ferrari ownership at its finest. We invite you to schedule a viewing and discover why this vehicle stands as a pinnacle of Italian automotive engineering and design.

The exterior parking camera and multiple airbags provide additional security and awareness.

- GT2 Bucket Seats
- Z07 Performance Package with carbon ceramic brakes
- 5.5L V8 engine with 8-speed dual clutch transmission
- Visible Carbon Fiber Carbon Aero with high-wing and dive planes
- 20" x 10" front and 21" x 13" rear gloss black forged aluminum wheels

The Z07 Performance Package elevates this Corvette with a comprehensive upgrade centered on track-ready capability. Carbon ceramic brakes paired with dark gray metallic calipers provide exceptional stopping power and thermal management. The suspension features Magnetic Selective Ride Control technology, allowing real-time damping adjustments for both street comfort and circuit performance. Michelin Pilot Sport Cup 2 R tires deliver the grip and responsiveness demanded by this machine's potential.

The exterior commands attention through purposeful design. Visible carbon fiber ground effects and an aggressive high-wing aero package reflect this Z06's racing heritage. Black forged aluminum wheels in a distinctive 10-spoke design anchor each corner, while black exhaust tips and a carbon flash-painted convertible top with matching nacelles complete the visual package. A front lift system with memory function adds practical convenience for everyday driving.

Inside, the GT2 bucket seats wrapped in Mulan leather with perforated inserts provide bold styling and support. The Stealth Interior Trim Package applies dark finish aluminum accents throughout, creating a focused cockpit environment. Dual-zone automatic climate control, heated steering wheel, and a comprehensive suite of driver aids ensure comfort and control whether navigating city streets or pushing limits on open road.

Technology integration flows seamlessly through the Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium System, which includes navigation, performance data and video recording capability, and wireless device charging. A heads-up display projects critical information onto the windshield, keeping your focus forward. The Bose Performance Series audio system with 14 speakers delivers quality sound regardless of top position.

Safety and security features include HD front and rear vision cameras, rear cross traffic alert, side blind zone alert, and a comprehensive airbag system. Battery protection packaging and multiple theft deterrent sensors provide additional peace of mind. OnStar connectivity and emergency communication systems stand ready when you need them.

This Corvette Z06 2LZ combines visceral performance with refined daily-use capability. With 12 city MPG and 19 highway MPG, this machine expresses its engineering intent clearly. The convertible design and modern amenities accommodate your lifestyle while the Z07 package and carbon aero ensure this vehicle performs as aggressively as it appears. Come experience this achievement in automotive excellence firsthand.

description:
2006 Aston Martin DB9 Volante

There's something about a dark, understated color combination on a car this dramatic that makes the shape do all the talking. This example wears a deep navy paint over a blue and tan leather interior with wood trim, and comes offered with six previous owners and 25,000 miles on the clock. Power comes from Aston's 6.0-liter naturally aspirated V12, producing 450 horsepower and 420 lb-ft of torque, sending the DB9 to 60 mph in roughly 4.7 seconds on its way to a claimed top speed of 186 mph genuinely quick numbers for a grand tourer built as much for long-distance comfort as outright speed.

Visually, this Volante rides on multi-spoke alloy wheels that stand apart from the DB9's more common five-spoke design, giving the car a slightly more contemporary stance, while chrome side strakes ahead of the front wheel arches and a color-matched fabric top complete a clean, cohesive exterior presentation. The soft top folds away beneath a hard tonneau that sits flush with the bodywork when lowered, preserving the DB9's silhouette whether the top is up or down.

Inside, the blue and tan leather pairing is set off by rich wood trim across the dash and console, reflecting the level of hand-craftsmanship Aston Martin built into every DB9 at its Gaydon facility in England. The result is a cabin that feels every bit as considered as the exterior, with the kind of detail glass ignition button, counter-rotating tachometer that has always set Aston Martin's interiors apart from the rest of the segment.

Combining one of the most timeless shapes in modern Aston Martin history with a distinctive color combination and the open-air appeal of the Volante body style, this DB9 offers a compelling opportunity to acquire a genuinely handsome, well-documented example of British grand touring at its best.

Convenience
  • Unresponsive driver assistant - a reaction to inaction. Maybe you fell asleep. Maybe you lost consciousness. No matter how it happens, Unresponsive driver assistant works to help lessen the danger when it does. It detects prolonged driver unresponsiveness, automatically bringing the vehicle to a stop and turning on the hazard lights. If equipped, emergency services will also be contacted. Unresponsive driver assistant is safety that never sleeps.
Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
  • Lane departure prevention - Keep it between the lines. It only takes a moment of inattention for your vehicle to drift. With lane departure prevention, your vehicle takes corrective action to help you avoid unintentionally moving out of your lane. Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you.
  • Active blind spot system - Protect your blind side. You checked the mirror, looked over your shoulder and still nearly collided with the car next to you. An active blind spot system not only alerts you to the presence of a vehicle to your sides or rear but helps prevent you from making an unsafe lane change. Replace fear and uncertainty with the confidence and safety of the Active blind spot system.
  • Head-up display - Keep your head up! You don't have to take your eyes off of the road to get information from your dashboard anymore. With head-up display, important driving information - like speed and RPM's - displays on your windshield in your line of sight. Because when you're driving, the most important information lies on the road ahead. Keep your eyes on the road with head-up display.
  • Brake assist - Stop right there. Something jumps out into the middle of the road and you need to stop now! With brake assist, you will. It uses the speed of the brake pedal's travel to sense panic braking, then applies all available power to boost your stopping power. Brake assist can stop the accident before it is one.
Technology and Telematics
  • Apple CarPlay and Android Auto Compatibility smart device wireless mirroring
  • Mobile hotspot - WiFi on the fly. Connect your devices to the Internet through your vehicle's private mobile hotspot and take the internet wherever your journey takes you, without eating up your data allowance. Find the hotspot with mobile hotspot.

This 2025 Ford Mustang EcoBoost Premium in Silver stands as a refined expression of American performance and style. With its turbocharged 2.3L EcoBoost engine paired to a 10-speed automatic transmission, this rear-wheel-drive vehicle delivers capable performance while achieving 20 city and 28 highway MPG. The Silver exterior catches light beautifully, complemented by body-color bumpers, heated power door mirrors with turn signal indicators, and a distinctive rear spoiler.

The interior welcomes you with ActiveX bucket seats finished in leather, a heated steering wheel, and dual-zone automatic climate control that keeps all occupants comfortable. The power convertible roof opens up possibilities for open-air driving whenever the mood strikes. SYNC 4 infotainment keeps you connected with smartphone integration and SiriusXM 360L satellite radio through nine premium speakers.

Comfort and convenience features abound throughout the cabin. Climate-controlled heated and cooled front seats, power-adjustable front seats, and a leather-wrapped sport steering wheel create an inviting driver's environment. The overhead console, locking center console, and multiple storage bins provide practical organization for your journey.

Safety and security remain paramount in this Mustang's design. Dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, and a knee airbag work with electronic stability control and traction control to protect occupants. The active anti-theft system, wheel locking kit, and security package provide peace of mind. An exterior parking camera and rear parking sensors assist with maneuvering, while auto high-beam headlights and speed-sensing wipers enhance visibility in various conditions.

The Equipment Group 200A Standard Package and Security Package make this Mustang well-equipped from the factory. Four-wheel disc ABS brakes, speed-sensitive steering, and four-wheel independent suspension provide confident handling. The fully automatic headlights and delay-off feature add practicality to daily driving.

This one-owner Mustang EcoBoost Premium combines the iconic appeal of the nameplate with modern comfort, technology, and capability. We invite you to experience this vehicle in person and discover why it deserves a place in your garage.

description:
The 2016 Chevrolet Camaro SS is a two-door performance coupe with a lower, tighter body than the previous generation and proportions that place emphasis on the mechanical components beneath its sheet metal. Its exterior design uses short overhangs, a long hood, and a narrow cabin, with details that are shaped by the car's performance role rather than decorative excess. The SS trim sits near the center of the Camaro range and is identified by its V8 powertrain and associated hardware. Chevrolet engineered this generation around a lighter architecture than before, which contributed to changes in mass distribution and helped define the car's road manners. The cabin opening is compact, and access is typical of a coupe of this type, with the driver seated low relative to the beltline and windshield.

Inside, the interior follows a driver-oriented arrangement with controls grouped closely around the front seats. The included leather seats add a more finished surface to the seating areas, and the cabin materials are arranged with a mix of soft-touch and molded surfaces. The instrument panel has a layered design, and the center stack is angled slightly toward the driver. Chevrolet placed a prominent display in the upper field of view, and this example includes a Head Up Display. The seating position and window openings create the expected coupe feel, with limited rear-seat accommodation and a cargo area sized for the vehicle class. Switchgear, vents, and storage areas are integrated into the dash and console rather than spread across the cabin, which keeps the interior familiar to anyone who has spent time in modern performance cars.

The infotainment equipment includes Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, which give the central screen access to phone-based interfaces when connected. A Wi-Fi Hotspot is also present. The system is arranged with conventional on-screen menus and physical controls nearby, so basic functions remain accessible without relying only on touch inputs. Premium Audio is included as well, adding a higher-grade sound system to the list of equipment. Audio, phone integration, and connectivity functions are handled through the same general interface, while the driver can also use the steering wheel controls and the display cluster to monitor common information. The electronic features are integrated into the car rather than appearing as separate aftermarket additions, and they reflect the equipment Chevrolet offered for this model year.

The SS name is associated with the Camaro's V8 drivetrain, and the car's character follows from that hardware. The chassis uses a rear-wheel-drive layout, and the suspension and steering were tuned to support brisk acceleration, stable high-speed behavior, and responsive cornering on paved roads. Braking performance is part of the package expected of this trim, and the body structure was developed to support the demands of a higher-output engine. The vehicle's controls, seating position, and outward visibility are consistent with a focused two-seat-plus-small-rear-seat coupe, and the cabin packaging leaves the driver with a clear sense of the car's dimensions. For a 2016 Camaro SS, the important points are the V8 powertrain, the coupe body, the leather seating, the head-up display, the connected infotainment system, the Wi-Fi Hotspot, the Premium Audio, and the Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility, all of which are present without needing embellishment.

description: The 2011 Chevrolet Camaro 1LT is a remarkable vehicle that perfectly marries exhilarating performance with modern conveniences and state-of-the-art technology. Powered by a 3.6L V-6 gasoline direct injection engine, this beauty generates an impressive 312HP and is coupled with a 6-speed manual transmission, making every drive an unforgettable adventure.One of the standout features of the Camaro 1LT is its *brake assist* system. This innovative technology enhances your stopping power by detecting panic braking situations and applying maximum brake boost to help you stop efficiently and safely. Its particularly advantageous in emergency scenarios, allowing you to respond quickly to any unexpected situations on the road.Moreover, the *selective internet access* feature elevates your driving experience by allowing you to customize your information feed with sports scores, local news, and weather updates. This means you can stay informed and entertained while on the move, making your journeys considerably more enjoyable.Comfort is paramount in the Camaro 1LT, which features a *power convertible roof* that allows you to enjoy the open air with just the touch of a button. Whether it’s a sunny day or you need to shield yourself from sudden weather changes, this feature enhances your driving pleasure effortlessly. Furthermore, the vehicle offers a range of *power seat adjustments*, including reclining, fore/aft, height adjustment, and cushion tilt, ensuring that every driver can find their ideal position for comfort and safety.Performance-wise, the Camaro 1LT is equipped with *variable valve timing*, which optimizes engine efficiency at various RPMs for improved fuel economy and reduced emissions. Coupled with *gasoline direct injection*, this technology maximizes power delivery while minimizing noise, resulting in an exhilarating yet whisper-quiet ride.Safety is also a top priority in the Camaro 1LT. It features an *ignition immobilizer* that prevents unauthorized vehicle startup, along with a *tracker system* that monitors your vehicle’s location. This ensures peace of mind, whether you’re concerned about a teen driver or recovering a stolen vehicle.In conclusion, the 2011 Chevrolet Camaro 1LT stands out not just as a muscle car but as a harmonious blend of sporty design, innovative technology, and luxurious comfort. Perfect for those seeking excitement without compromising on practicality, the Camaro 1LT promises an unforgettable driving experience. Don’t miss out on the opportunity to own this iconic vehicle that continues to captivate enthusiasts with its powerful performance and advanced features!

The distinctive exterior styling includes the RS Package upgrades—20-inch painted aluminum wheels, high-intensity discharge headlamps, and RS-unique tail lamps—all contributing to an aggressive, intentional appearance. The convertible roof and rear spoiler complete the commanding profile that turns heads wherever you drive. With 43,925 miles on the odometer, this Camaro remains well-preserved and ready to deliver years of enjoyment.

We invite you to visit our showroom to experience this Camaro SS 2SS firsthand and discover why it remains a compelling choice for drivers who appreciate authentic American performance.

This 2008 BMW Z4 3.0i is a two-seat roadster with a focus on clean proportions and a compact footprint. Its long hood, short rear deck, and low seating position give it the familiar shape associated with the Z4 nameplate. The body lines are simple and restrained, with a profile that emphasizes the car's length and the opening of the cockpit rather than unnecessary surface detail. This model was built to offer open-air driving in a format that keeps the cabin close to the driver and passenger, with the top folded away when conditions allow.

This BMW is powered by a 3.0-liter inline six-cylinder engine, which is paired with a rear-wheel-drive layout. The engine provides smooth operation and a linear response that suits this chassis. Acceleration and passing ability are in keeping with a six-cylinder sports roadster, and the car's balance is supported by a low seating position and a relatively short wheelbase. Steering is direct, and the suspension tuning is consistent with a vehicle intended for composed road use while still allowing the driver to make use of the engine's range. This 3.0i designation identifies the model's engine specification and places it within BMW's Z4 lineup from that period.

This example includes leather seats, which give the cabin a more finished appearance and a surface that is easy to maintain. The seating position is low, and the controls are arranged within reach of the driver. Keyless entry is also present, allowing access without using a traditional key at the door. Rain sensing wipers are included as well, and they add automatic adjustment based on changing weather conditions. The car also has side impact airbags, which are part of its occupant protection equipment. Fog lights are fitted to the front of the vehicle and are integrated into the exterior lighting package without altering the restrained look of the nose.

This 2008 BMW Z4 3.0i uses a compact two-passenger cabin, so storage and passenger space are limited in the way expected for a roadster of this size. The interior is oriented toward the front seats and the driving position, with simple switchgear and a straightforward instrument layout. Visibility, seating height, and the open top contribute to the car's road use character, while the engine and chassis give it the ability to cover pavement with a steady, controlled feel. This BMW keeps its equipment list focused on core comfort and safety items rather than extensive luxury additions, and the available features are presented in a manner consistent with the car's purpose.
